title: Body Composition Update Staleness
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bodycomp:reading
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by profile_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which profiless have gone quiet for body-composition weigh-ins.
value: Stale weigh-ins are useful to surface because the trendline becomes noise long before anyone notices.
implementation: Send body-composition weigh-ins events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of profiless with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which profiless have gone quiet longer than they should for body-composition weigh-ins.
